name: Central nuclear plant supplies four separated campuses
assumptions: Twelve uranium generators at 100 percent produce 30 GW. Fuel production and water pumps are outside this collection-island boundary.
Each generator row is a separate local LV collection island in the stepped layout. The comparison treats the export node as the feed of an aggregate transmission island.
Exported factory demand is lumped at each station transformer. Factory internal losses and transformer conversion losses are excluded.
Four campuses are copies of the Tier 7, Tier 8, Tier 9, and extreme-pulse scenarios. Their simultaneous worst-case peaks size the backbone.
Coordinates in meters set straight transmission spans. Railway HV and wire HV use the same tier parameters; no train traction or regeneration is modeled.
